message: {filter} zeros/poles must come in complex-conjugate pairs: their expanded polynomial is not real
description: A filter with real coefficients has complex roots in conjugate pairs (`a+bj` and `a-bj`). These roots have no partner, so the filter they describe has complex coefficients, which a real circuit cannot realize.
actions: Give every complex root its conjugate: `{-1, 2, -1, -2}`.
